svg.text: RC timing branches A / B (4-bit trim)
SR latch, reset switches, clock out
q=1: A charges through RA (rsta=0), B held at 0 (rstb=1). va > vdd/2 -> ca=1 -> q=0, B charges. en=0 -> q=0, both banks held, osc_clk=0.
Half period = R C ln2 + comparator/latch delay; threshold is a fixed fraction of vdd, so f is first-order independent of vdd.
